summary: SEC-1 is closed: the documented Approve sequence records approved, checkpoints into pr before any push, and set-status pr-open is gated under lock with passing tests; the one new defect is a low-severity single-quote composition site in the brainstorm cruise bullet.

findings.summary: The new brainstorm cruise bullet composes the model's recommended answer into a single-quoted shell argument, so a recommendation containing a single quote breaks out and runs shell text (ENG-25).
findings.evidence: SKILL.md line 66: `answer <qid> '<recommended>' --auto --stage brainstorm`. Reproduced quote breakout with a stand-in sh -c line. Same class as round-1 SEC-2 (protocol.md line 110), which this fix leaves unaddressed; this delta adds a brainstorm site.
findings.fix: Pass recommended answers without shell composition (e.g. `answer <qid> --recommended`, reading the recommendation from state, or stdin/file), or require single-quote escaping before composing the shell line. Apply to every cruise bullet that composes '<recommended>'.
